definitions.explanation: Catching or killing fish, animals or plants faster than they can recover, so that their numbers fall.

examples.japanese: {乱獲|らんかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Fish have decreased because of overfishing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{象|ぞう}→象：03328_zou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{象牙|ぞうげ}→象牙：31708_zouge⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乱獲|らんかく}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Elephants were overhunted for their ivory.

examples.japanese: {乱獲|らんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{漁|りょう}→漁：31785_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}められている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: To prevent overfishing, the fishing season is fixed.

notes:
Used of fishing, hunting and plant gathering, and figuratively of anything taken in excess. As a verb it is mostly passive: {乱獲|らんかく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱獲|らんかく}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧: extinction caused by overhunting
- {乱獲|らんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent overfishing
- {乱獲|らんかく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be overfished, overhunted

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {密漁|みつりょう}: poaching — illegal fishing or hunting, which may or may not be excessive
- ⟦{卵殻|らんかく}→卵殻：27690_rankaku⟧: eggshell — same reading, unrelated
